newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rebels ambush soldiers, attack police.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rebels ambush soldiers, attack police.

text.p: Tamil Tiger rebels killed 22 soldiers and five policemen when they ambushed an army patrol and attacked a police post in eastern Trincomalee district on Sunday, military officials said.
They said an army road clearing patrol was attacked by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels at Pulmoddai, north of Trincomalee early on Sunday.
"Reinforcements had been rushed to quell the attack and fighting is now over," said a military official in Trincomalee, 240 km (150 miles) east of the capital Colombo.
A military spokesman said in Colombo that 22 soldiers were killed in the ambush and four were wounded.

Miitary officials said that the rebels later attacked a police post at Pallikdiyurippu. Five policemen were killed and one was seriously wounded. The officials had earlier put the death toll in the attack at six.
"Five policemen have died and one is critically wounded," one military official said in Trincomalee.
He said that two civilians had been wounded in the attack and they had been admitted to Trincomalee hospital.
"An army platoon had rushed to the site and it had opened mortar fire at the terrorists," the official said. He said the rebels had escaped.
The military spokesman in Colombo said that it was not immediately known whether the LTTE had suffered any casualties in the two incidents.
An LTTE spokesman was not immediately available for comment on Sunday's attack.
The LTTE, who are fighting for an independent homeland in Sri Lanka's north and east, said they killed 23 soldiers in another ambush in the eastern Batticaloa district last week.

They said in a statement from London on Sunday that the rebels had intercepted an army patrol near Valaichchenai, near Batticaloa, 220 km (130 miles) east of Colombo and lost two of their fighters in the gunbattle that lasted some 15 minutes.
Military officials put the army casualty toll at 12.

The statement said the rebels had also killed four soldiers in a separate attack on Friday near the main Sri Lanka army camp in Batticaloa. There was no immediate confirmation available from the military.
The goverment says more than 50,000 people have been killed in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE says the number is higher.
